 (1USAORL)                                                            
 (LINAC,1USAORL) Oak Ridge Electron Linear                            
           Accelerator (ORELA)                                    
 (PHOTO) Neutrons were produced by photoneutron                       
           reaction using oak ridge electron linear accelerator.  
           ORELA was operated at a repetition rate of 525 Hz, a   
           burst width of 8 ns, and a power of 5 to 6 KW.         
 (SCIN) 6Li glass scintillator 0.5-mm-thick placed at                 
           a distance of 39.695 m from the neutron target was     
           used to measure neutron flux. Pair of deuterated       
           benzene (C6D6) detectors for gamma rays.
